text: Phase 1 implementation plan: first add a non-identity affine contract test and split round evidence into work matches used for tangent projection and endpoint matches lifted through the current midpoint arms for sparse fixed-to-moving error. Extract a package-private frozen true-CC evaluator from HalfFlowCc rather than duplicate objective semantics: baseline warp, support build, and NeighborhoodCc preparation once; evaluate every alpha by candidate rewarp and valueWith on the same frozen weights; rebuild support only after acceptance. Add one atomic BasinBridge round that validates input, warps native sources, obtains oracle or native matches, projects, assimilates, and if accepted rewarps and rematches once. Return typed diagnostics for match distributions, CC and support, projection, alpha trials, Jacobians, and post-rematch residual. Close only after actual-CC accept/reject tests, support-freeze instrumentation, one-rematch proof, non-identity, swap, boundary, flat, and zero-confidence adversarial tests, fixture check, focused and full JVM/Scala.js gates, and a new receipt. The native matcher and reverse-search adapter now exist; the previous blocker text is stale on that point.
